lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid of approximately six horizontal rows and ten vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance are visible, with the circular blobs positioned precisely at the intersection points where these vertical bands cross the horizontal planes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower values on the ventral side, indicating a raised ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized toward the base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the lateral flank; one is positioned posterior to the first dorsal fin and the other is located near the pelvic fin region.
